Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.storage

Class DeepSlot

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.storage.DeepSlot
public final class DeepSlot extends Object
An immutable slot of a ChestStorage: one item type with a long count. A slot with a prototype and a zero count only exists while it is locked.

    • of

      public static DeepSlot of(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack prototype, long count, long remainder, boolean locked, boolean voiding, @Nullable @Nullable net.minecraft.world.item.Item compressionForm)
      Create a normalized slot.
      Parameters:
      prototype - The item type, its count is ignored.
      count - The amount of items.
      remainder - For a compressed slot, the base units that do not make a whole item of the prototype.
      locked - If the slot is locked to its type.
      voiding - If automated inserts of its type that do not fit are destroyed.
      compressionForm - The item of the compression form to extract in, or null (or air) for the default.
      Returns:
      The slot, EMPTY if nothing is stored and nothing is reserved.

    • getCompressionForm

      public Optional<net.minecraft.world.item.Item> getCompressionForm()
      The form, as an item, that the player picked to extract this slot's contents in. Stored as an item rather than a position in the compression family, so it survives datapack changes to the family. If the item is no longer a form of the slot's family, the largest form should be used.
      Returns:
      The picked form, or empty for the default (the largest form).
